title: Ask for what you need
name: I need…
summary: A highly reusable structure for shops, services, and everyday life.
rule: Brauchen takes a direct object. Store useful nouns as ready-made chunks: Hilfe, einen Termin, eine Quittung.
avoid: Avoid Ich brauchen. With ich, the form is brauche.
note: You can soften this by adding bitte: Ich brauche eine Quittung, bitte.
